4. Acknowledgment of the above for the file"},{"spec_id":"spec_0442","text":"GRANITERIDGE HEALTH - Patient Access Services
Incident Review: Registration Downtime, 4 March
Organizer: Yoko
Date/Time: Tuesday 14:00-15:00
Location: Conference Room B / Teams [link]

Attendees (15): Ben Achterberg, Dmitri Nwachukwu, Lucia Haddad, Mei Varga, Thandi Nwachukwu, Marcus Grummond, Registration leads (4), IT Applications (3), Billing liaison, Compliance

First, I am very sorry for sending this so late, and sorry also that it is landing in a busy week for everybody. I tried to find better time but calendars are very full.

Agenda
1. Timeline of the event (Yoko) - already summarized in the incident report [link], I will go through it again in order
2. Root cause as was confirmed by IT Applications (Dmitri N.) - interface engine certificate was expired, it is now renewed
3. Impact to the Carvalho account billing (Lucia H.) - 41 encounters are re-queued, all are resolved as of Friday
4. Corrective actions already put in place (Marcus G.):
   - certificate expiry alert added to monitoring
   - downtime paper forms restocked at all desks
   - updated downtime procedure is posted [link]
5. Sign-off of the report (Thandi N.)

Pre-reading: Incident report v3 [link], Downtime procedure rev. 2 [link]

Again apologies for taking one hour from all of you. If you cannot attend, please kindly let me know and I will make sure you receive the notes after.

Thank you for your patience,
Yoko"},{"spec_id":"spec_0443","text":"ASHCREST CREATIVE
Session: Yarrow migration - Walkthrough for All Account Teams
Organizer: Maeve
Duration: 60 minutes (11:00-12:00)
Invitees: Account Management, Studio, Traffic (19 total)
Room: Large Boardroom + video link

Purpose
To make familiarization of staff with the Yarrow migration and related matters.

Agenda
1. Opening remarks (Maeve) - 5 min
* Background of migration, already announced in all-staff memo of last month
- Login credentials which will be sent from IT to each person individually
2. Platform walkthrough (Emeka Kowalczyk) - 25 min
  - where is located the asset library
  - how to find the client folders (same structure as before)
  * naming convention, reference doc attached
3. Timeline review (Fatima Achterberg) - 10 min
- Old system read-only from 1st of month
- Full switch on 15th
4) Approvals flow (Wes Gallo) - 10 min
   * no change to the approval steps, only the button is in other place
5. Q&A - 10 min

Attachments: Yarrow_Quickstart_Guide.pdf, Naming_Convention_v2.pdf, Screen recording of demo (Goran Eriksen)

Attendance is requested for all invited personnel. Please to confirm your participation through calendar response. Questions in advance may be submitted to Yusuf Pruitt or Andre Castellano.

Regards,
Maeve
